title: Proof of the Lyons--White Conjecture
summary: Let $D_n$ be the dihedral group of order $2n$. Consider a continuous-time random walk on $D_n$ driven by arbitrary symmetric rates whose support generates $D_n$. For $p\in[1,\infty]$, we say the pair $(D_n,p)$ is rate-monotonic if for each fixed time $t$, the $\ell^p$-distance between the random walk's distribution at time $t$ and the uniform distribution is monotonically decreasing as a function of the rates.
